arabic text: ROTE HUWE SARWAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: O mourners, offer Zahra condolences for the Prophet; weeping, offer her condolences for Sarwar.

arabic text: HAR EK MUHAMMAD KA FARMAN BHI ROTA HAI\nJIBREEL BHI ROTE HAI, QURAN BHI ROTA HAI\nAAYAAT KE MASDAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: Every command of Muhammad weeps;\nJibraeel weeps, and the Qur'an weeps.\nOffer condolences for the source of the verses.

arabic text: QUDRAT KE KHAZANE KI PEHCHAAN KARAYI HAI\nJIS AHMED E MURSAL KI MAMNOON KHUDAAI HAI\nTAWHEED KE GOHAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: He revealed the treasures of creation,\nthe sent Messenger Ahmad to whom all creation is indebted.\nOffer condolences for the jewel of tawheed.

arabic text: TATHEER KI AYAT KO PARHTE THE JAHAAN AAQA\nUMMAT NE WOH ZAHRA KA DARWAZA JALA DALA\nJALTE HUWE US DAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: Where the Master recited the verse of purification,\nthe nation burned Zahra's very door.\nOffer condolences for that burning door.

arabic text: JAB GHAR PE HUWA HAMLA ZAHRA KE YE THI SAR PAR\nKYUN KAR NA LAGA HOGA MOHSIN KA LAHU IS PER\nTATHEER KI CHADAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: When the home was attacked, the chadar was upon Zahra's head.\nHow could Mohsin's blood not have touched it?\nOffer condolences for the chadar of purification.

arabic text: HAQ INKA BHI CHEENA AUR HAMLA BHI KIYA GHAR PAR\nGARDAN ME RASAN BANDHI DARBAAR GAYE LEKAR\nMAZLOOMI E HAIDER KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: They seized his right and attacked his home.\nA rope was tied around his neck and he was taken to the court.\nOffer condolences for Haider's oppression.

arabic text: UMMAT KO NA CHAYN AYA YOON ZEHR KHILA KAR BHI\nTEERO’n KO CHALAYA HAI TABOOT KE UPER BHI\nTUKRE DIL E SHABBAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: The nation found no peace even after giving him poison;\nthey also shot arrows upon his funeral bier.\nOffer condolences for Shabbar's heart torn into pieces.

arabic text: HAR DAUR ME UMMAT NE KYUN DHAAYE SITAM POOCHO\nKIS JURM ME ZAHRA KE MARA GAYA BACHO’n KO\nMOHSIN, ALI ASGHER KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: Ask why the nation committed oppression in every age.\nFor what crime were Zahra's children killed?\nOffer condolences for Mohsin and Ali Asghar.

arabic text: GHAR APNA LUTA KAR BHI ISLAM BACHAYA HAI\nAUR NOKE SINA PER BHI QURAN SUNAYA HAI\nNEZE PE UTHE SAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text: Even after sacrificing his home, he saved Islam,\nand recited the Qur'an from the spear-point.\nOffer condolences for the head raised upon the spear.

arabic text:
ABBAS KARIM AISA UMMAT NE SITAM DHAYA
MARA ALI AKBAR KE SEENE ME HASSAN NEZA
HUM
SHAKL E PAYAMBAR KA PURSA DO AZADARO
english translation text:
O Abbas and Karim, the nation committed such oppression:
a spear was driven into the chest of Ali Akbar,
the likeness of the Prophet.
Offer condolences for him, O mourners.
